messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: anomalous token billing spike for tenant "Aurora-DataWorks" (tenant_id=aurora-12) in dedicated-pool eu-west-1. Meter shows +900k tokens in 9m vs baseline 18k. Link: https://console.redwood/incs/1779991234

Maya Singh: paging. grabbing the thread. anyone on-call for eu-west-1?

Owen Park: i'm here. seeing lots of small generation calls to model-rw-1b from a handful of hosts in the customer's VPC. throughput spike aligns with 2026-05-18T02:10Z.

Nina Gomez: telemetry alert: our metering proxy emitted 940k token events. accounting job shows ~84k uniques. tagging @BillingBot and @TelemetryBot.

TelemetryBot: started job metering-reconcile(aurora-12) at 2026-05-18T02:18Z. ETA 7m.

BillingBot: reconcile in progress. hypothesis: repeated identical requests plus NAT amplification. Collecting sample msg_ids.

Ravi Kapoor: can we do a soft isolation? propose diverting Aurora traffic to a rate-limited queue and spin a smaller fallback model. don't want to fully cut them.

Maya Singh: agreed. apply soft throttle 80rps + daily token cap 5M for aurora-12. also route new requests to model-compact-0 to limit cost. I'll coordinate with infra.

Lena Ortiz: updating route:
```
redwood route update --tenant aurora-12 --throttle 80rps --daily-cap 5000000 --fallback model-compact-0 --pool eu-west-1
```

Lena Ortiz: policy applied. observed immediate drop to ~35rps.

Owen Park: proxy logs show bursts of repeated message_id across multiple seconds. sample:
```
[2026-05-18T02:11:07Z] req id=aa7b1 token=512 path=/v1/stream client_ip=172.31.9.5 status=200
[2026-05-18T02:11:08Z] req id=aa7b1 token=512 path=/v1/stream client_ip=172.31.9.5 status=200
[2026-05-18T02:11:09Z] req id=aa7b1 token=512 path=/v1/stream client_ip=172.31.9.5 status=200
```
multiple repeats across seconds.

Maya Singh: hmm. could be client retry + upstream LB. Nina, can you reach out to Aurora SRE?

Nina Gomez: pinging Aurora SRE slack (SRE:Aurora DataWorks) and their escalation email now. sending initial summary.

SRE:Aurora DataWorks: thanks for the heads up. we'll check our gateway logs and NLB health. can you share the suspicious msg_ids?

TelemetryBot: attaching a trimmed sample list of repeated msg_ids in a secure link: https://console.redwood/artifacts/aurora-sample-1779991234

BillingBot: reconciliation finished. meter_count: 943212; accounting_unique: 87216. duplicate_count: 855, - i.e., ~856k duplicates. proposed billing credit: 856, - sorry, 856, - wait formatting: 856, - compute: 943212 - 87216 = 855,996 tokens to credit.

Ravi Kapoor: approved to apply credit pending legal review. let's ensure we include the offset in this week's batch.

Maya Singh: open ticket ENG-13109: vpc-metering-dedupe-hotfix. assign to eng-infra, priority P0. also create billing ops ticket BILL-4431 for credit processing.

Lena Ortiz: ENG-13109 created. plan: enable dedupe-by-message_id in metering proxy for VPC flows, canary in eu-west-1 small, run 2h smoke, then roll.

Owen Park: note for postmortem: why did proxy not honor idempotency headers? did NAT strip headers? collect header traces.

SRE:Aurora DataWorks: we found a misconfigured health probe causing our gateway to return 502 intermittently which caused retries. we'll patch timeouts and disable aggressive client retry for now.

Maya Singh: handing off monitoring to @Owen Park for the night. if token delta > 50k in 10m re-escalate to P1.

BillingBot: billing ops flagged. scheduled credit: pending legal sign-off. we will include reconciliation artifact and list of unique msg_ids.

TelemetryBot: added runbook references: infra/runbooks/vpc-metering.md and billing/runbooks/credit-adjustments.md

Maya Singh: thanks team. leaving for customer bridge call. keep this thread updated. closing primary alert but keeping open for the hotfix and billing closure. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: incident 1779991234 status=mitigated, severity=high, customer=aurora-12, mitigation=soft-throttle+fallback-model+billing-credit-proposal, ticket=ENG-13109
file_notes: Slack thread capturing live incident coordination for Aurora DataWorks token metering anomaly in a dedicated VPC pool. Contains run commands and reconciliation summary.
